title: ImpactGraph effective-LOC exceptions
description: Reviewed, expiring exceptions to the 300-effective-line limit (ADR-0012). Kept in sync with the Zod schema in scripts/quality/effective-loc/src/exceptions.ts.

path.description: Repo-root-relative posix path of the excepted file. Must exist.

reason.description: Why the file cannot be split yet, and the plan to remove the exception.

owner.description: Person accountable for removing the exception.

reviewBy.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). quality:loc fails once this date has passed.

maxLines.description: Raised effective-line limit for this file.
